taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-06 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 857.1 | 0.64 | 0.64
2 | 996.7 | 0.52 | 1.16
3 | 83.1 | 1.53 | 2.69
4 | 335.1 | 3.03 | 5.72
5 | 27.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-06
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: >5.72 m (Layer 5, ρ = 27.9 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target the drilling program below 5.72 m depth, where resistivity drops sharply to 27.9 Ω·m, suggesting a saturated, permeable zone consistent with an aquifer; confirm lithology and water strike with drill cuttings/geophysical logging as this layer’s thickness is unconstrained by the VES data.
